recognize_zh: 視野中央有一條水平走向、內襯扁平內皮細胞的小動脈，其兩側緊貼一至數層核卵圓、胞質淡紅的早期顆粒球前驅細胞，較成熟的中性球與紅系細胞則分布在較遠處，示範正常的血管旁（periarteriolar）顆粒球生成位置。
features: Small arteriole with thin pink wall and flattened endothelial nuclei coursing horizontally across the field
Perivascular cuff of immature granulocytic precursors with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Maturing neutrophils, eosinophil precursors with bright orange-red granules, and erythroid clusters with small dark round nuclei located away from the vessel
Macrophages containing golden-brown pigment and phagocytosed debris
Normocellular marrow with interspersed adipocytes; no clusters of blasts in central marrow
describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy at intermediate power shows normocellular trilineage hematopoiesis. A small arteriole courses horizontally through the field and is cuffed by immature granulocytic precursors with oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, while more mature neutrophils, eosinophilic precursors and erythroid islands are located farther from the vessel. Scattered macrophages contain golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin. No abnormal clusters of immature cells, fibrosis or infiltrate are identified. Findings illustrate the normal periarteriolar localization of granulocytic precursors.

ddx.dx: Abnormal localization of immature precursors (ALIP) in myelodysplastic neoplasm
ddx.vs: ALIP refers to clusters of myeloblasts/promyelocytes in central intertrabecular marrow away from both trabeculae and arterioles, whereas these precursors hug the vessel wall.
Lymphoma cells would be a monotonous atypical population filling or cuffing vessels without admixed eosinophilic granulocytic maturation.
Mast cell aggregates are often perivascular or paratrabecular but consist of spindled cells with clear to pale cytoplasm, admixed eosinophils and fibrosis, and are CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive.
